title: Y Combinator CEO Garry Tan open-sourced his personal AI knowledge system
description:
Y Combinator CEO Garry Tan open-sourced his personal AI knowledge system. gbrain is long-term memory for AI agents. Everything you know—people, companies, deals, meetings—stored as Markdown files in a Git repo.While you sleep, it scans your conversations, emails, meeting transcripts. Enriches entities, creates cross-references, builds a knowledge graph. You wake up. Your digital brain got smarter overnight.

https://github.com/garrytan/gbrain

#github #opensource
